patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff does not apply to the vulnerable workspace snapshot, so fixed-side validation used the authoritative n132/arvo:44089-fix image instrumented with fixed-instrumentation.patch. That image reaches the same numeric parse call with the repaired token-end terminator predicate true and runs clean.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project parser statement that materializes vulnerability-relevant state from the attacker-controlled JSON bytes: the primitive token boundaries later reconstructed as the numeric slice parsed by `parse_primitive`.

The numeric parser passes `str_val` directly to `strtol` even though the only valid bound is the separate pointer `str_end`. No bounded copy or NUL termination is performed before using a C-string API that scans until a terminator or non-digit.
ASan sink at the project call site. `strtol` interprets the one-byte token slice as a NUL-terminated string and over-reads the heap input buffer while searching for the byte after `'3'`.
